capabilities: Render Handlebars template blocks using frontmatter variables
Iterate notes in the vault with the notes helper
Generate internal links with the link partial
extras: Author notes it lacks configurable partials/helpers and syntax-error indicators, keeping the plugin under 100 lines; users customize manually.
problem: Obsidian's core templating doesn't support the Handlebars template engine for generating Markdown inside notes.
summary: Handlebars templating plugin that renders template blocks in notes with frontmatter variables, a notes helper, and a link partial.
